title: Crisis lines (crisis_resources.yaml)
description: Required file; may be an empty list. Read by catalog_loader.load_crisis_resources into app.models.CrisisResource. Listed by the agent's get_crisis_resources tool; lines with crisis_topic are this place's local crisis lines, named in the crisis interrupt and on the matching risk flags next to the built-in national lines (911, 988, 1-800-799-7233).

phone.description: Number as displayed, quoted (for example '911', 512-472-4357). A line whose phone is a built-in national number is not repeated as a local line.

crisis_topic.description: Marks a local crisis line for that topic. Omit for general lines.
